shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; ls -R /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ----; ls /home/sandbox/workspace; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json

find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat "{}"'; echo "=== index.html"; cat index.html; echo "=== tsconfig"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "=== vite"; cat vite.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo "=== i18n grep"; rg -n -i -C 4 'i18n|lang|locale' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; echo "=== node_modules gravity"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Select Text Card Flex Button Label 2>&1 | head -60; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup d.ts"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>&1; echo "=== Card d.ts"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo "=== Label d.ts"; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts; echo "=== Text d.ts"; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo "=== uikit i18n keysets"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -name 'en.json' | head -30; echo "=== Pagination keyset"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ClipboardButton/i18n/en.json 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/index.js 2>/dev/null; echo "=== uikit i18n util"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils -name 'i18n*' ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/i18n/index.js 2>/dev/null
